annotations.title: Post a Group Assignment to a Room

description: Posts a group assignment to a room the person has joined. Every member of that room sees it at once and can run it separately; nothing is reviewed first. quest_type is teach_back, bridge_finder, source_quest or field_report; 1 to 10 steps; an evidence requirement; optional timebox.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

steps.description: 1-10 steps, each an action rather than a vibe, up to 600 characters. Blank steps are rejected.
